summary: Sun Country Airlines Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that it entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Allegiant Travel Company on January 11, 2026. Under the agreement, Allegiant will acquire Sun Country through a two-step merger process, with Sun Country surviving the first merger and then merging into an Allegiant subsidiary. Allegiant filed a Form S-4 registration statement declared effective March 31, 2026, and both companies mailed joint proxy statements to stockholders. Special stockholder meetings are scheduled for May 8, 2026 to vote on the transaction. Two lawsuits challenging the merger have been filed in New York state court, and demand letters alleging omissions in the proxy statement have been received. The transaction is subject to stockholder approval and regulatory clearances. Watch for the May 8 vote and potential litigation outcomes.
